# Google Play (9 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /app-search | `query` | 5 | Search Google Play apps by keyword |
| /search-suggestions | `query` | 1 | Get Google Play search suggestions |
| /app-info | `app_id` | 5 | Get full Google Play app details |
| /app-reviews | `app_id` | 5 | Get Google Play reviews for an app |
| /app-list | `app_collection` | 5 | Get a Google Play store chart |
| /app-listings-search | `title` | 10 | Search the Google Play listings database (paginated) |
| /categories | *(none)* | 1 | List Google Play app categories |
| /locations | *(none)* | 1 | List supported Google Play storefront locations |
| /languages | *(none)* | 1 | List supported Google Play languages |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /app-search — 5cr

Returns a unified AppList of Google Play apps matching a keyword — title, icon, developer, rating, price/is_free, and store URL on every item, on the same canonical `App` shape used across every app marketplace (`app.store` = "google_play"). Detail-only fields (description, screenshots, installs) are null on search items; fetch /v1/google_play/app-info for the full record. Sourced from DataForSEO's task-based App Data API (first calls ~7-15s, then cached).

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keyword (e.g. 'photo editor').
- `country` *(optional)*: Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name ('United States'), or a numeric location code ('2840'). Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of results to retrieve (default 30, rounded up to multiples of 30, max 300). Note: Google Play's organic keyword search typically exposes only ~30 ranked results, so higher depth values rarely return more. To page deeper for app discovery, use /v1/google_play/app-listings-search (a filterable title/description database with real limit/offset/total).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search-suggestions — 1cr

Returns Google Play's search autocomplete suggestions for a keyword stem — the same terms the store's search box surfaces. The day Play starts autocompleting a phrase, real demand exists; poll a stem daily and diff to catch rising app keywords early. Each item is `{ term, priority }` ranked by Play's own order (Play exposes no numeric score). Returns a list under `items`.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Partial search keyword to autocomplete (e.g. 'reverse').
- `country` *(optional)*: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 storefront country code. Defaults to 'us'.
- `language` *(optional)*: ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to 'en'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/search-suggestions?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /app-info — 5cr

Returns the full canonical `App` record for one Google Play app keyed by its package name (`app_id`) — title, description, developer block (incl. email/address/website), rating, price, install count + display ('1,000,000,000+'), version, size, screenshots, genres, chart tags, similar apps, and update date. The `app.store` field is always "google_play"; Apple-only leaves (advisories, languages) are null. Get the `app_id` from /v1/google_play/app-search. Sourced from DataForSEO's task-based App Data API.

**Parameters**

- `app_id`: Google Play package name (e.g. 'com.spotify.music'), from app-search.
- `country` *(optional)*: Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-info?app_id=<app_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /app-reviews — 5cr

Returns a unified ReviewList of Google Play user reviews for an app, keyed by its package name (`app_id` on every review's `entity_id`). Each review carries the star rating, full text, reviewer name + avatar, helpful-vote count, developer `responses[]` (reply text + date), and publish date — on the SAME canonical `Review` shape used by Amazon, Google Shopping, and Trustpilot. Google reviews have no title (always null). `depth` returns reviews in batches of 150 (max 600). Sourced from DataForSEO's task-based App Data API.

**Parameters**

- `app_id`: Google Play package name (e.g. 'com.spotify.music'), from app-search.
- `country` *(optional)*: Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (default 150, batches of 150, max 600).
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Review ordering: `newest` (default) or `most_relevant`.
- `rating` *(optional)*: Filter to a single star rating (1–5).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-reviews?app_id=<app_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /app-list — 5cr

Returns a unified AppList for a Google Play store chart (top free, top paid, top grossing, movers & shakers, etc.), optionally scoped to a category. Each item is the same canonical `App` shape as app-search. Use it to track ranking movements or build a category leaderboard. Sourced from DataForSEO's task-based App Data API.

**Parameters**

- `app_collection`: Chart to retrieve: topselling_free, topselling_paid, topgrossing, movers_shakers, topselling_new_free, topselling_new_paid.
- `app_category` *(optional)*: Optional Google Play category to scope the chart (e.g. 'photography', 'game_puzzle').
- `country` *(optional)*: Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of apps to retrieve (default 100, max 500).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-list?app_collection=<app_collection>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /app-listings-search — 10cr

Searches DataForSEO's real-time, filterable Google Play listings database by app title (and/or description) and returns a unified AppList. Unlike the store-chart endpoints this one is the ONE true paginator — page with `limit` (≤50) + `offset` (then `offset_token` for deeper) and read the platform-wide `total`. Premium-tier because the upstream bills per returned item. Sourced from DataForSEO's synchronous live App Data database.

**Parameters**

- `title`: App title to search for (e.g. 'photo editor').
- `description` *(optional)*: Optional app-description text to match.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Apps per page (1–50, default 20).
- `offset` *(optional)*: Pagination offset (up to 10,000; use offset_token beyond).
- `offset_token` *(optional)*: Opaque deep-pagination cursor from a prior response. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead — the API maps it to this name for you.
- `filters` *(optional)*: Advanced DataForSEO filter expression as a JSON array.
- `country` *(optional)*: Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim — the API maps it to this endpoint's native `offset_token` (cursor style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-listings-search?title=<title>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /categories — 1cr

Returns the list of Google Play app categories used by the `app_category` filter on /v1/google_play/app-list. Static reference data — heavily cached.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /locations — 1cr

Returns the locations (name + numeric location code) supported by the Google Play App Data endpoints. Use a code or name as the `country` param. Static reference data — heavily cached.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/locations" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /languages — 1cr

Returns the languages (name + code) supported by the Google Play App Data endpoints. Use a code as the `language` param. Static reference data — heavily cached.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/languages" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Google Play endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| What apps exist for this keyword? | `/app-search` | 5 |
| Cheap keyword expansion (what people type) | `/search-suggestions` | 1 |
| One app's full listing | `/app-info` | 5 |
| What users complain about | `/app-reviews` | 5 |
| Who is ranking in a category chart | `/app-list` | 5 |
| Deep, paginated listings-database search | `/app-listings-search` | **10** |
| Category / storefront / language reference | `/categories` · `/locations` · `/languages` | 1 |

### Use the 1cr endpoints to aim the 5cr ones

`/search-suggestions` (1cr) is store-autocomplete — real user queries, and the cheapest
keyword research in this platform. Confirm categories and storefronts with `/categories` and
`/locations` (1cr) before paying 5cr for a chart that may not exist in that market.

`/app-listings-search` (10cr) is for attribute-filtered database search; ordinary keyword
lookup is `/app-search` at 5cr.

### Pair with the App Store, or let Prism do it

This platform mirrors `app_store` endpoint-for-endpoint. To cover both stores you pay twice
and then have to title-match the same app across them yourself. `prism/apps-lookup` (30cr)
does the resolve-and-compare in one call; `prism/app-reviews` (15cr) returns cross-store
review intelligence, translated and clustered. For one or two apps the manual route is
cheaper; past that, Prism wins.
